commits.subject: Capture standalone Jedis connection initialization errors
Capture standalone Jedis connection initialization errors

diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate required-status gate, not a separate source failure. reusable-pr-build.yml:62-89 deliberately runs exit 1 when common or test-latest-deps fails. The frozen children are fully diagnosed below: the PR-attributable Jedis initialization error-attribution failure is fixed in the native candidate; the independent AsyncHttpClient TLS timeout and transient Sentinel promotion timeout are unrelated and are not changed. This candidate does not claim that every CI job is green.

All six failures are AsyncHttpClientTest.httpsRequest() timing out in the legacy Netty TLS handshake on Java 25. The test makes an HTTPS request to its local test server; the affected async-http-client implementation, its tests, and the shared HTTP test are unchanged by this Jedis-only PR. The exception occurs in the Netty SSL handshake rather than a Jedis operation or changed code. No unrelated TLS workaround is included, and no rerun is requested because this frozen Actions run is already at attempt 3.
evidence: java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException: java.net.ConnectException: Handshake did not complete within 10000ms

diagnoses.analysis: The reproducible failure is coldPooledCommandFailureIsAttributedToApplicationCommand(): both CLIENT SETINFO initialization spans have null error.type instead of ERR. Jedis 8.0.2 eagerly obtains a connection in the UnifiedJedis constructor, before an instrumented application command is attached. attachForConnectionInitialization() incorrectly returned null without such an enclosing request, causing sendCommand spans to end before their Redis error replies. The fix always attaches the existing scoped initialization context, preserving reply-based completion and restoration. Regression coverage verifies ERR on initialization spans and duration metrics, plus a successful later command, on Jedis 4.0, 5.1, and frozen latest 8.0.2. The same job also records one Sentinel promotion timeout: its unchanged test polls the external Redis Sentinel process for ten seconds and reports that it did not promote the replica, before testing post-failover instrumentation. That independent server-timing failure did not recur in the recorded retry and is not changed.
evidence: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Sentinel did not promote the replica

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

Classify Redis server errors for Jedis 2, 3, and 4+ on spans and database duration metrics. A confirmed `WRONGTYPE details` reply produces `error.type="WRONGTYPE"`.

Preserve usable ASCII prefixes verbatim. Dedicated server exceptions, non-ASCII or missing prefixes, and client failures retain exception-class fallback. Successful operations omit `error.type`.

Propagate actual failures through command, pipeline, and transaction completion, including error results returned inside batches.
